verdict.rationale: Fin's own docs say it connects to business tools through MCP or API Data Connectors. Ready-made connector templates exist for Stripe, Shopify and Statuspage, and Procedures let Fin handle queries that involve third-party systems, so Fin can ground answers in live customer data beyond help articles. However, the evidence is thin marketing copy and never shows answers drawing on plan, order status or account history specifically. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Fin answers personalized with plan, order status and account history; detail on how connector data is used in answers; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, answers use the customer's live data — plan, order status, account history — not just generic help articles

citations.quote: It works through MCP or API Data Connectors for your business tools
Data connector templates are now generally available, with ready-to-install templates across Stripe, Shopify and Statuspage.
Procedures let you train Fin to handle queries with multiple steps, business logic and third-party systems from start to finish.
Train Fin on your knowledge, data, policies, and tone of voice.
